name: typography
title: Typography
description: The brand's type as components: regular-weight tight-tracked headings, body, lead, muted, small, quotes, lists, inline code and a plain table.
usage: Use for long-form text: a changelog entry, a guide, an announcement. The sizes follow the surface: on the site H1 is the section title, inside a product area the dashboard's compact scale. Use TypographyInlineCode for endpoints, keys and flags in a sentence. For data use Table.

reference.source: context-dashboard c0ddf7a src/app/globals.css (the type scale), with the brand heading defaults
reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
